description: Free exact-decimal calculation from caller-supplied prices, fees and setup costs for a planned number of calls. Separates locked capital and batches; unknown costs stay unknown. Compares complete profiles only within the same currency. No exchange-rate conversion, external fee measurement, payment or verification of supplied inputs.

currency.description: Denomination for every amount in this profile. Codes remain distinct; no conversion or peg assumption.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative amount in the profile currency's whole units, not atomic units. At most 30 integer and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation.

locked_capital.description: Caller capital held separately from expenditure, in the profile currency, or null when unknown. Excluded from totals.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative amount in the profile currency's whole units, not atomic units. At most 30 integer and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation.

network_per_call.description: Additional network expenditure borne by the caller per call, or null when unknown.

payment_per_call.description: Caller payment for the purchased service per call, in whole profile-currency units. Included in modeled expenditure.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative amount in the profile currency's whole units, not atomic units. At most 30 integer and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation.

provider_per_call.description: Additional fee paid by the caller to the provider per call, beyond payment_per_call. Not the provider internal operating cost.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative amount in the profile currency's whole units, not atomic units. At most 30 integer and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation.

settlement_cost.description: Additional caller expenditure per settlement, or null when unknown. Omission remains unknown.

settlement_every_calls.description: Calls per settlement. Default 1; the final incomplete batch incurs one full settlement cost.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative amount in the profile currency's whole units, not atomic units. At most 30 integer and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation.

setup_cost.description: One-time setup expenditure borne by the caller for this workload, or null when unknown.

observed_at.description: Caller-stated UTC timestamp at or before report generation. Not independently authenticated.

url.description: Caller-supplied HTTPS source reference without credentials, query or fragment. Never fetched.

workload.description: Shared caller-defined workload identifier. One call denotes the same declared unit of delivered work in every profile; equivalence is not verified.

name: estimate_payment_costs
title: Calculate workload costs from supplied payment profiles
